figures shown above a horizontal lower element
horizontal ground/base line running across the scene

justification: Both show a pair of upright human figures arranged in a row above a long horizontal element that runs the width of the scene, and both include a curled hook shape at the right (a ram's horn versus a boat prow), but these are generic coincidences. A depicts a naturalistic profile procession of bearded men leading horned rams with fleece, drapery and facial detail, while B is a radically schematic silhouette of two stick-like figures standing in a boat, with no animals and no anatomical detail.
